data.one_liner: Web implementation of file_selector for selecting files in Flutter web.
data.what_it_does: Provides file selection APIs for Flutter web, including openFile, openFiles, getSaveLocation, and mimeType support. It is automatically included when using file_selector and requires no extra pubspec entry.
use_when: Selecting files in a Flutter web app
Need to support cancel event or mimeType on XFile
Using file_selector as a dependency and want web support automatically
avoid_when: Relying on cancel event in very old browsers
strengths: Handles cancel event for modern browsers
weaknesses: Cancel event support limited to recent browsers

alternatives.name: file_selector
alternatives.why_pick_it: Platform-agnostic implementation that includes web support via this plugin
